description: Client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11: displays observed ender pearl throws beside player nametags.

mods.name: Pearl Counter — mhv1
mods.description: Shows each player's observed ender pearl throws beside their nametag.

releases.notes:
Initial release for Minecraft Java 1.21.11 (Fabric).

- Ender pearl icon and observed throw count beside player nametags.
- Duplicate pearl protection; counters reset on observed death or world change.
- Local reset command: `/pearlcounter reset`.
- Custom project icon. Fabric API is not required.

Install `pearl-counter-mhv1.jar` in your profile’s `mods` folder with Fabric Loader 0.19.3+ and Java 21.

Only pearls received by the client can be counted. Build, 16 counter checks and Minecraft Mixin checks passed; live multiplayer visual testing is still pending.
